subject: Mystic River Gas Line Installation
overview: The Conservation Commission continued a hearing on a Riverside Avenue stormwater project and approved a Notice of Intent with conditions for a Boston Gas Company pipeline installation crossing beneath the Mystic River.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the November 2, 2022 meeting.

items.title: Riverside Avenue Notice of Intent
items.summary: Continued the hearing to December 7, 2022, following discussion of updated drainage calculations, bioretention sizing, swale stabilization, and coordination with DCR trail construction.

items.title: Boston Gas Company Mystic River Crossing
items.summary: Approved an Order of Conditions with conditions concerning dewatering, erosion controls, spill response, and tree protection for horizontal directional drilling of a gas main beneath the Mystic River.
